# E09: Later stone-tool communities and shelters

**Window:** Mesolithic labels and local transitions; dates require individual evaluation.

**Question:** What do shelter deposits and tool assemblages reveal without forcing a pan-regional sequence?

## Evidence presently available in this seed

The teaching overview identifies Thenmala/Tenmala and Ankode as relevant stratified shelter contexts and points to earlier research.

Source routes: [S010](../sources/S010.md), [S025](../sources/S025.md).

## What this does not establish

The overview’s 5210-years-ago statement cannot be converted into a precise BCE year without the original measurement and calibration. Its description is not a warrant to label every Kerala Mesolithic assemblage microlithic.

## Research tasks

- [ ] Retrieve the cited Rajendran reports and identify laboratory numbers.
- [ ] Preserve original BP values, uncertainty, calibration curve, material and context.
- [ ] Compare flake technologies and microliths rather than assuming one diagnostic toolkit.
- [ ] Document food remains, seasonality and mobility only where deposits support them.
